violations.text: Raw animal foods (chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (pasta and cooked potatoes) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Chicken was moved to bottom of storage rack during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings in the storage room and back entrance way. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings. Establishment is to work with licensed pest control. Establishment is to increase pest control. Establishment is to have pest control do a full evaluation of establishment. Importance of Pest Management in School document provided. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the kitchen. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels or similar internal temperature device. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the blower fans in the walk in cooler, and of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS are to be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2026

The cafe floor and under equipment has an accumulation of soil residue, rodent droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Corrective Action - Establishment is to continue to work with pest control, establishment is to check for and clean any and all droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 05/04/2024
